reason: An agent-driven DeepSeek Harness plugin that compacts long conversation histories by having the agent produce a validated summary and replacing prior history through the compaction protocol.

summaries.zh: 通过让智能体总结自身上下文并替换历史记录，帮助 DeepSeek Harness 压缩过长的会话。
summaries.en: Compacts long DeepSeek Harness conversations by having the agent summarize its own context and replace prior history through the compaction protocol.

capabilities: Injects a compaction instruction into the agent inbox
Replaces conversation history with a validated compacted summary
Integrates with the DeepSeek Harness compaction protocol
